title: Reverse is refused while a payment is applied
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the Net 30 credit term.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced for $100.00 with a $40.00 payment from customer B applied, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Reverse the invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab lists customer B's invoice with Balance $60.00 ($100.00 − $40.00).

Step 3:

  • Reverse is refused, as it is today while a payment is applied.
  • The invoice stays and work order 1 stays Invoiced.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12313 (Story 11, Reverse and invoice again)

  • S11-N1: “With anything applied, Reverse is refused as today; staff reverse payments or deposits first.”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Reverse the invoice | n/a | As today: refused while any payment, deposit or credit is applied; reopens the work order to Complete | n/a”
